title.value: Dissociating memory accessibility and precision in forgetting
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning and throughout the paper.
title.quote: Dissociating memory accessibility and precision in forgetting

analysis.description: This paper investigates the nature of forgetting in memory and whether it involves losses of accessibility or precision over time. The research examines word-location associations to assess changes in memory retention over several days.

type.justification: The paper involves conducting experiments on memory retention across different time intervals and analyzing empirical data.
type.quote: We assessed memory for word-location associations across 4 days, testing whether forgetting involves losses in precision vs accessibility.

name.justification: The study involves cognitive experiments related to memory, which falls under psychology and is connected to neuroscience when analyzing mechanisms behind memory retention.
name.quote: The Psychology and Neuroscience of Forgetting

name.justification: The paper's focus on understanding memory processes and mechanisms aligns with the field of cognitive science.
name.quote: forgetting involves losses in memory accessibility with no changes in memory precision.

name.justification: The paper investigates specific aspects of memory, including accessibility and precision, which are central topics in memory studies.
name.quote: To summarise, we used online testing, precision memory measures, and mixture modelling to assess forgetting across time.
